title: Roadmap Orchestra playbook for cross-team dependency weeks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook (the 'Orchestra') to run recurring 1-week dependency windows around major roadmap changes. This ticket captures the scope, roles, comms, and checklist for two objectives: 1) reduce cross-team unblock time during critical rollouts, and 2) produce an auditable handoff for Exec/Board readouts and post-rollout retros. The playbook standardizes pre-window validation, live coordination, and post-window regression checks so that PM, Eng, and Design have a shared cadence for complex initiative merges and infra migrations.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Published playbook page in Confluence with runbook, templates, and roles
A2: Two pilot 'dependency weeks' scheduled and staffed in Cycle 2026-W12 and 2026-W16
A3: Slack coordination channel template and incident contact list created
A4: Post-pilot runbook revisions captured and a one-page exec summary prepared for the monthly roadmap update
deliverables: Confluence: Roadmap Orchestra runbook (pre-window checklist, live ops matrix, rollback triggers)
Google Sheet: dependency tracker with automated blocker aging column
Slack: #roadmap-orchestra channel template with pinned playbook links
One-page exec readout deck for monthly QBR and Board packets
Retrospective template and action tracker (Linear subtasks)
timeline: Week 1: Draft runbook and templates. Week 2: Stakeholder review and pilot schedule. Week 3: Pilot dependency week #1. Week 4-5: Collect metrics, adjust playbook, prep exec one-pager. Pilot #2 in Cycle 2026-W16. Finalize for org roll-out by 2026-03-28.
success_metrics: Average blocker resolution time during dependency windows reduces by 35% vs baseline
Number of unplanned rollbacks during pilot windows = 0
Stakeholder satisfaction score >= 4/5 in pilot survey
Exec readout accepted without additional follow-up questions
